offer.text: Nobody has walked the drove road since the bridge went. Get yourself to the next village and back, and tell me whether it is still a road or just a rumour.

accept.text: Keep the river on your left and you cannot miss it.

in_progress.text: The next village along, not this one.

ready.text: You have been. I can see the mud on you.

complete.text: Then it is a road. I shall tell the drovers.

failed.text: Two days. It should not take two days.
